recipes.title: 20-Minute Mackerel & Borlotti Bean Pasta

items.i: sea salt, for the pasta water
extra-virgin olive oil, plus more to finish
mackerel fillets in olive oil (about 120 g)
walnuts or pistachios, crushed, to serve

steps: Warm the olive oil in a large sauté pan over low–medium heat. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil.
Add the crushed garlic, oregano and chili and cook gently without letting it sizzle hard. Add the olives and capers.
Season with pepper, add the chopped tomatoes and simmer.
Stir in the borlotti beans. Drop the pasta into the boiling water and cook 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Add the mackerel fillets and peas, folding gently so the fish stays in chunks.
Lift the pasta straight into the sauce with a spider so some pasta water comes with it, and stir gently.
Fold through the rocket, then serve topped with crushed nuts, a drizzle of olive oil and Parmesan if you like.
recipes.notes: Method from the video narration. The full written recipe is behind a sign-up link, so ingredient amounts, servings and nutrition are estimates. Swap the mackerel for white fish, prawns or leftover chicken.
